{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Identify and remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Filter out QA orders from the loyal_completed population
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue on clean data
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Number of loyal, completed, non-QA orders: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")
print(f"Mean revenue (clean): {mean_revenue_clean}")"}
